corrections.reason: Joining with L14 'ማ-', the printed word has four glyphs 'ሠሪያዋ' (forming 'ማሠሪያዋ', translating Ge'ez 'ማዕሠራ' = her bond); 'ሪ' and 'ያ' were visually merged into 'ሯ' in Stage 1.
Canonical Ge'ez perfect verb with object suffix 'ወዘርአ' (and he sowed it, translated by Amharic 'የዘራትን'); the 4th-order 'አ' is printed on the page.
The printed glyph clearly shows 2nd-order 'ሁ' with the right-side vowel stroke ('ሁነች'), preserving the authentic archaic Andemta spelling.
